Summary of "Nine characteristics of great teamwork"

Teamwork in professional settings is rapidly changing. Teamwork means working together to achieve a shared goal. 

Effective teams are built in environments that are trusting, supportive, and nonjudgmental. 

The best teams are self motivated.

Teams need:
- good communication
- individual talent
- sense of belonging
- strong leadership
- clear structure
- achievable goals
- feedback
- positive attitude
- solution-focused members

The best teams are a combination of these traits. They are willing to work hard together, collaborate, communicate effectively, and work towards a common goal.
